conventions.array_hash_definition: SHA256 of NumPy array.tobytes(order=C); dtype and shape stored separately
conventions.base_integrator: explicit midpoint with SO(3) rotation exponential and exact exponential actuator filtering; one base substep at dt .01 because max substep .025
conventions.effective_application_dtype: float32, jax.config.x64_enabled false; params, norms and inputs cast by model.rollout
conventions.history_reconstruction: filtered command initialized from first past command then exponential lag scan over all 50 past commands; hidden initialized zero then updated over contexts 10..49; last 10 current-feature rows become explicit history
conventions.initial_condition: last observed canonical history state; no native actuator state supplied to learner
conventions.observation_memory_timing: history and hidden fixed during substeps; advance each once from observation-start features, after all substeps
conventions.target_alignment: target is observed native_states[1:]; predictions contain 120 future states, excluding initial state
conventions.target_location: each query NPZ, array target; no separate target files

minimum_proof_recommendations: Authenticate external protocol, binding, model, query, target and saved prediction anchors before any rollout; no repaired local inventory can replace external anchor.

Require base n=1 traced endpoint predictions to reproduce each of the 30 saved query/arm predictions, dtype/shape/finite masks and np.array_equal(equal_nan=True); instrumentation that changes arithmetic fusion may require distinct uninstrumented exact replay plus explicitly bounded traced agreement. Freeze that policy prospectively.
Replay trace generation from the saved 2 models and 15 queries without fits, simulators or controller calls; preserve all 90 combinations, including finite huge trajectories and nonfinite results.

Use an independent NumPy-only reducer to recompute contribution sums, norms/state growth, first nonfinite steps and convergence comparisons from saved trace arrays; report predeclared comparisons without choosing substeps by score.

Execute at least an externally anchored input/model alteration rejection and a valid saved-trace or summary alteration rejected by replay/reducer after local inventory repair. Corrupt an actual meaningful finite numeric value, not syntax or only NaN payload bits.
No new native-truth replay needed if consuming the already sealed and verified native artifacts unchanged; retain existing native replay receipts as provenance.
